title: BIG Challenges
body:
BIGChallenges: The Ultimate Survival Test 💀
BIGChallenges is a mod designed for those who find vanilla Minecraft too easy. It introduces a set of treacherous blocks and dangerous mechanics that will turn your world into a deadly obstacle course.

Key Features:

⚡ Redstone light: A block that strikes lightning 1.5 seconds after contact. Can you dodge it in time? and it power redstone and it light!

🧨 Nitro Liquid: A volatile fluid that detonates instantly upon touch. No more safe swimming!

🧩 Fake Bricks: When you destroy this block, Lava appears in its place, and the same thing happens if you power it with redstone.

🎲 Randomer: A block with a random effect—test your luck!

🍫 Chocolate & Trash: A quick snack to restore energy, but don't forget to deal with the wrapper!

Many new structures have appeared in version 1.0.1, such as a chocolate factory or even a laboratory. Many new materials have appeared, such as ruby. Ordinary rubies are nothing special. Armor made of obgotok has appeared. It is not very strong, so don't think that it is like iron. Nitro wood has appeared, which makes your challenges more difficult. There are also many new commands, such as setting a checkpoint in a certain place. There are even items that can spawn lightning.
Perfect for: Trolling friends, creating hardcore parkour maps, or just pushing your survival skills to the limit.

Are you brave enough to face the BIGChallenges?
